meta.title: Clafina: run the whole business from one place
meta.description: Books, stock, sales, people and your online shop on one record, with a till, a phone app and an assistant reading the same numbers.

hero.title: Run the whole business from one place.
hero.lede: Books, stock, sales, people and your online shop on one record, with a till, a phone app and an assistant reading the same numbers.

oneRecord.title: One sale. Everywhere it matters, at once.
oneRecord.intro: A sale at the till is not four jobs in four systems. It is one record that everything reads.

steps.title: The till sells
steps.body: A cashier charges table 6 by cash, transfer or card. The till keeps selling if the connection drops.

steps.title: Stock moves
steps.body: The dishes and the stock behind them come off that branch, so the next order sees what is really left.

steps.title: The books post
steps.body: The sale, the VAT and the service charge post to the ledger by themselves. Nobody types them in again.

steps.title: The owner sees it
steps.body: Today's sales on the phone app change as it happens, next to what needs attention.

surfaces.title: One business, on every screen it uses
surfaces.intro: Staff use the screen that suits the job. Every one of them reads and writes the same numbers.

items.title: The web app
items.body: Books, sales, stock, people and projects. Every page says what it is for and what to do next.

items.title: The till
items.body: Sells on desktop, on Android and in the browser, and keeps going offline within the limits you set.

items.title: Your online shop
items.body: Built in Storefront Studio in your own brand, selling from the same stock and the same prices.

items.title: The phone app
items.body: Your numbers, approvals, sales and stock counts in your pocket.

items.title: The assistant
items.body: Drafts replies, sums up long conversations, sorts what comes in and takes meeting notes.

items.title: Meet
items.body: Video calls and audio rooms of your own, started from any chat.

modules.title: Everything a business runs on
modules.intro: Use what you need today. The rest is already there when you grow into it.

items.product-payments: Collect, pay out and see every movement of money.
items.product-tax: VAT and withholding worked out on every document.
items.product-business-health: Dashboards and reports that agree with the books.
items.product-sales: Quotations, orders, waybills, invoices and receipts.

items.product-pos: A till for shops and restaurants that sells offline.
items.product-online-shop: Your own shop in your own brand.
items.product-trading-network: Send orders and invoices straight to other businesses.
items.product-stock: Products, units, variants and stock in every place.
items.product-purchasing: Requests, purchase orders, receiving and paying suppliers.
items.product-manufacturing: Bills of materials, work orders, quality and true cost.
items.product-bookings: Rooms, tables, people and equipment that cannot double-book.
items.product-projects: Projects, tasks and timesheets you can bill.
items.product-assets: What you own, where it is and when it needs service.
items.product-communication: Inbox, team chat, templates and Meet.
items.product-mobile: The phone app for owners and staff.
items.product-assistant: Help with the writing and the reading.
items.product-capture: Scan a receipt or say it out loud; Clafina fills the form.
items.product-integrations: An API, webhooks and connections to your other tools.

industries.title: Your trade's words, your trade's work
industries.intro: One core with packs on top. A hotel sees Guests and Stays, a charity sees Donors, a workshop sees Jobs.

works.title: Built for the way business really runs

items.title: Keeps selling offline
items.body: The till carries on when the connection drops and catches up when it comes back.

items.title: Every currency
items.body: Every amount carries its currency. The books keep the rate and the gain or loss.

items.title: Your customer's language
items.body: Invoices and emails go out in your customer's language when you have a template for it.

items.title: Always current
items.body: Screens change the moment something happens. Nobody presses refresh.

trust.title: Built to be trusted with your money

items.text: Two-step sign-in, and single sign-on with SAML or OIDC.
See every device that is signed in, and sign any of them out.
Passwords and keys for your connections are sealed and never shown again.
A finance audit trail that cannot be quietly changed, and no approving your own payments.
Our support team reaches your account only when you allow it, read-only and recorded.
Certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II.
